content.title: Chapter 6 - ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES — Sec. 6-152. - Definition.
content.summary:
"Tastings" means the sampling of malt, vinous, or spirituous liquors that may occur
               on the premises of a retail liquor store licensee, fermented malt beverage and wine
               retailer licensee, or liquor-licensed drugstore licensee by adult patrons of the licensee
            …

faqs.a:
"Tastings" means the sampling of malt, vinous, or spirituous liquors that may occur
               on the premises of a retail liquor store licensee, fermented malt beverage and wine
               retailer licensee, or liquor-licensed drugstore licensee by adult patrons of the licensee
               pursuant to the provisions of C.R.S. § 44-3-301(10).
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018; Ord. No.
4839
, § 1, 3-20-2023)
